name: Reconstruction
description: Damage dealt by abilities restores Domina's shields. It does not repair Barrier Array.

name: The Best Defense
description: Damaging enemies with abilities grants temporary overhealth that fades after a short time.

name: Siphon Blaster
description: Temporarily switch to a semi-automatic pistol with explosive, life-stealing rounds, moving faster and jumping higher. Firing builds heat, and overheating ends it early.

name: Revdraw Crossbow
description: Automatic crossbow that fires a rapid stream of bolts.

name: Jagged Blade
description: Throw a blade that wounds the enemy it hits. Activate again to recall it, pulling an impaled enemy toward you. Quick melee also wounds.

name: Incendiary Chaingun
description: Fire Gunny, an automatic chaingun that sets enemies on fire after enough hits.

name: Volatile Chaingun
description: Fire Cha-Cha, an automatic chaingun that deals critical damage to burning enemies. Firing both chainguns together slows your movement.

name: Block (Nemesis Form)
description: Hold to brace and reduce incoming damage from the front.

name: Nemesis Form
description: Transform for a short time, gaining bonus armor and movement speed. Void Accelerator and Void Barrier are replaced by Pummel and Block.

name: Dire Triggers
description: Fire both shotguns in a quick two-blast volley with a tighter spread and a longer effective range.
